skill.name: agile-ceremonies
skill.description: Guides agile teams through daily standups, retrospectives, sprint planning, sprint progress updates, action-item capture, and team health checks.
skill.summary: Run structured agile ceremonies with reusable standup, retrospective, progress, and action-item formats.
skill.author: Joseph OBrien

content.value_statement: Agile teams need concise ceremonies that keep work visible and action items clear. This skill provides standup, retrospective, sprint progress, and team health formats for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Structures individual, team, and asynchronous daily standups.
Creates sprint progress summaries with burndown, story status, risks, and decisions.
Facilitates retrospectives with sprint metrics, learnings, action items, and follow-up tracking.
Captures blockers, owners, due dates, and required support for follow-up.
Documents team health signals, mood checks, recognition, and process improvements.
limitations: Does not connect directly to Jira, GitHub, Slack, or Discord.
Requires user-provided sprint data, team updates, and metrics.
Does not calculate velocity or burndown from live project systems.
Templates may need adjustment for non-Scrum or highly regulated workflows.

use_cases.title: Prepare Daily Standups
use_cases.description: Turn team updates into a concise standup agenda with blockers, planned work, and action items.

use_cases.title: Run Sprint Retrospectives
use_cases.description: Organize wins, problems, learnings, team health, and accountable improvements after each sprint.

use_cases.title: Report Sprint Progress
use_cases.description: Summarize sprint status, risks, decisions, metrics, and next priorities for stakeholders.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Basic Standup
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a daily standup for [team name]. Include yesterday, today, blockers, and action items. Keep it concise and easy to share.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Async Updates
prompt_templates.scenario: Team members posted updates in chat
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize these async standup updates: [paste updates]. Group work completed, planned work, blockers, owners, and required follow-up.

prompt_templates.title: Facilitate A Retrospective
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a sprint retrospective for sprint [number]. Use these metrics and notes: [details]. Include wins, issues, learnings, health signals, and action items.

prompt_templates.title: Build A Sprint Health Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced sprint status and risk review
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a sprint health review from this sprint data: [details]. Include progress, burndown summary, risks, decisions needed, team health, and next focus areas.

output_examples.input: Daily standup for five engineers with two blockers and three priorities.
output_examples.output: A concise standup agenda with individual updates, a blocker summary, named owners, and same-day follow-up actions.

output_examples.input: Sprint retrospective notes with velocity, team mood, wins, and problems.
output_examples.output: A retrospective summary covering what went well, what did not, root causes, learnings, team health, and accountable improvements.
A progress report with shipped work, active work, metrics, risks, decisions needed, and next week priorities.

best_practices: Provide current sprint goals, team names, known blockers, and relevant metrics.
Ask for owners and due dates when action items are created.
Review prior retrospective actions before generating a new retrospective.
anti_patterns: Do not use vague blockers without the support needed to unblock work.
Do not ask the skill to replace facilitator judgment or team discussion.
Do not omit sprint context when requesting progress summaries or retrospectives.

faq.question: What ceremonies does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports daily standups, async standups, sprint retrospectives, sprint progress reviews, team health checks, and weekly summaries.

faq.question: Can it help with asynchronous standups?
faq.answer: Yes. It can format chat-based updates into completed work, planned work, blockers, and follow-up actions.

faq.question: Does it integrate with Jira, GitHub, Slack, or Discord?
faq.answer: No. It uses information you provide and does not connect to external project or chat systems.

faq.question: Can it create retrospective action items?
faq.answer: Yes. It can turn retrospective notes into clear action items with owners, due dates, and follow-up status.

faq.question: Does it calculate agile metrics automatically?
faq.answer: No. It can organize metrics you provide, but it does not calculate live velocity, burndown, or cycle time.

faq.question: Is it useful with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The templates are text-based and work across Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
